items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: So I liked Jack Teagarden and I liked Benny Goodman, but my favorite trombone player was Lawrence Brown...

ctx.x: Yeah, well, that's right. Some French people were saying, what does that mean. I said, well, you ought to know, of all people. Jack means money, beaucoup --
A lot of money, beaucoup Jack, that's right.
